title: Word Search
goal: Solve Word Search: Follow orthogonally adjacent cells matching successive word characters, marking the current path and restoring it on return.
strategy: Follow orthogonally adjacent cells matching successive word characters, marking the current path and restoring it on return.
edgeCases: A cell cannot be reused within one word path; a failed branch must release its cells for other paths.
inputRules: Board must be 2D array of letters
All rows must have same width
